meta.title: ItalBridge Partners
meta.description: ItalBridge Partners helps Italian industrial manufacturers sell into Kenya and East Africa, and helps East African buyers source Italian equipment, with one accountable partner in Nairobi.

manufacturer.title: Sell into Kenya and East Africa without opening a local office.
manufacturer.text: We find and qualify buyers, structure the deal, run logistics and customs, and stay on as your after-sales contact in Nairobi.

buyer.title: Source Italian industrial equipment with a partner on the ground.
buyer.text: Tell us your specification. We match you with a vetted Italian maker, negotiate terms, deliver to your site and support you after commissioning.

card.text: Demand for industrial equipment in Kenya is rising fast. The question is who carries the deal from specification to service.
